jobs.description: Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients. About the Role: We’re looking for a highly consultative Dental Field Trainer in Germany to lead impactful, in-person training that accelerates early clinical success with Dandy’s digital dentistry solutions. This role is field-based, with up to 80% travel , and is focused on helping dental practices adopt intraoral scanning and digital workflows with confidence. You’ll serve as a trusted clinical advisor to dentists, practice managers, and operational leaders—helping teams adopt new technology, digital workflows, improve clinical performance, and accelerate early success. This role combines clinical training expertise with operational execution and post-training insight to deliver measurable value at the intersection of training, technology, and practice growth. Success in this role comes from your ability to earn clinical trust and turn that trust into action — helping practices move from curiosity to confidence. jobs.title: Math Teacher Eye Level PIK 2
jobs.description: Requirements : Minimum D3/S1, preferably in Mathematics, Mathematics Education, English Education, English Literature, or related fields. Experienced in teaching Primary and Secondary students, preferably in an international school or international curriculum environment. Able to explain mathematical concepts clearly, patiently, and systematically. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Teaching or tutoring experience is a plus. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Patient, disciplined, honest, responsible, committed, creative, and proactive. Tech-savvy and able to adapt to a structured learning environment. Willing to introduce and promote the Eye Level learning program to students and parents. Willing to undergo Eye Level training and follow the Eye Level teaching methodology. Well-groomed and professional in appearance. Willing to work onsite. General Responsibilities : Teach Mathematics to children aged 4-15 years old according to the Eye Level curriculum and teaching methodology. Provide academic coaching in a small-group learning environment based on each student's individual progress. Explain mathematical concepts clearly and guide students to develop independent learning skills. Motivate and encourage students throughout their learning process. Monitor, grade, and maintain students' academic progress and learning reports. Communicate effectively and professionally with students, parents, and Center staff. Introduce and explain the Eye Level program to prospective students and parents when needed. Perform administrative and operational activities related to teaching when required. Identify and report students' learning difficulties or other concerns to the Center Director. Participate actively in Eye Level training and other center activities.
